title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Applications for Acquisition)
(1) Where a private investor wishes to request that the Government acquire the investor's investment, the investor shall submit to the Financial Services Commission an application for acquisition of investment in the form prescribed by the Commission, accompanied by an investment certificate, a document prescribed in Article 54 (5) of the Industrial Bank of Korea Act, or any other document certifying the investment (hereinafter referred to as an "investment certificate"). [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
(2) The application referred to in paragraph (1) shall be submitted within the period determined by the Financial Services Commission for each fiscal year. [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
